messages:
sarah_support: FYI Acme Widgets hitting tool invoke failures on our Private (VPC) deployment since 08:45 UTC. Error includes missing required field + type mismatch + additionalProperties.

eli_infra: Can you paste the payload and exact validator errors? Also which cluster/pool is this on?

sarah_support: Truncated request they sent (redacted):
```
POST /v1/tools/invoke
{
  "tool": "billing/charge",
  "params": {
    "customer_id": 12345,           // int instead of expected string
    "billing_profile": { "id": null },
    "line_items": [ { "name": "widget", "unit_price": "9.99", "quantity": 1 } ],
    "client_trace_id": "abc-xyz-123", // extra prop from SDK
    "debug_mode": true               // not in server schema
  }
}
```

sarah_support: Validator response we get server-side:
```
ValidationError: instance.billing_profile.id is required
ValidationError: instance.line_items[0].unit_price is not of a type(s) (number)
ValidationError: Additional properties are not allowed ('client_trace_id', 'debug_mode')
```

tony_engineer: Looks like three distinct failure modes: required field missing (null id), type mismatch for unit_price, and strict additionalProperties blocking.

izzy_support: Customer says they're on SDK v1.2.0. Any known serialization quirks?

carlos_eng: Yes — SDK 1.2.0 can emit Money as formatted strings when locale formatting enabled; also tokenized payment flows left billing_profile.id null in some edge cases. We shipped fixes in 1.2.3 to normalize money to numbers and ensure id is populated for token flows.

maya_product: Did this start after a rollout? deploybot: Rollout note: feature_flag.strict_tool_schema_validation set true on private-canary pool at 2026-03-15T22:10:17Z (rollout id=ff-778).

eli_infra: That explains it — previously lenient schema tolerated extra keys and nulls; strict flag enforces additionalProperties=false and required checks.

sarah_support: Repro steps I ran from my laptop:
- curl copy of the payload => same validator errors.
- Change unit_price to numeric AND set billing_profile.id to a non-null string => request accepted.

izzy_support: Customer constrained by a regulatory date. They asked us not to flip flags without coordination.

tony_engineer: Remediation options:
- Customer upgrade to SDK 1.2.3 (fastest).
- Customer change payload to coerce numeric fields and set billing_profile.id.
- Rollback/soften strict flag in private-canary (fast for infra but risky).
- Medium term: add safe server-side coercion for numbers and null->emptystring mapping for billing_profile.id in the router (requires design + QA).

carlos_eng: I'll draft an upgrade note for the customer: 1) upgrade to SDK 1.2.3, 2) if upgrade not possible, ensure unit_price is a number and billing_profile.id is present, 3) remove client_trace_id/debug_mode from production payloads (those are internal-only and will be rejected under strict validation).

maya_product: Action: open support ticket SUP-9876, assign to eng-platform + SDK team, and escalate for customer SLA. Also ping compliance to confirm any change windows.

eli_infra: I'll inspect private-canary rollout logs and timeline; if we need to pause ff-778 I will coordinate with platform.

sarah_support: I've opened SUP-9876 and shared the quick mitigation steps with Acme: manual payload fix or SDK upgrade. Customer replied they will attempt SDK upgrade but need confirmation from our side before we change flags.

deploybot: Note: feature_flag.strict_tool_schema_validation rolled out to 10% of private clusters at 2026-03-15T22:10:17Z (rollout id=ff-778).

sarah_support: Leaving thread open until SUP-9876 closure. Escalate: eng-platform for potential router coercion, SDK for patch, and infra for rollout audit. cc: @tony_engineer @carlos_eng @eli_infra
note: thread records a short support escalation about JSON schema validation failures on private canary after strict validation flag enabled
